turns.doctor_question: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. Thank you for coming in today. What brings you to the clinic?

Well, thank you, Doctor. I guess what finally got me in here is that, over these past few months, my mind just keeps jumping all over the place. I'll be out on the road, and every little CB chirp, every fuel price sign I pass, or just some new idea that pops into my head completely takes my attention away. 

I'm starting to miss details that I normally never miss—things like a client's delivery note, or forgetting who I promised to call back. It's just getting in the way of my work, so I figured I better come in and talk to somebody about it.
